create.title: Add notification
create.introTitle: Connect notifications to a Telegram group
create.intro: Choose the market and the message type, then open the one-time link — the bot joins the group and connects it by itself.
create.qrAlt: QR code of the Telegram group connection link
create.step1: Open the link or scan the QR code with a phone that has Telegram.
create.step2: Choose the group — the bot joins it.
create.step3: The bot connects the group by itself, the list refreshes.
create.waiting: Waiting for the group to connect…
create.expiredHint: The link is valid for 10 minutes and works once. Get a new one.
create.command: Add the bot to the group and send this command there:
create.existsTitle: A group of this type is already connected
create.exists: {{market}} already has a group of this type (ID: {{groupId}}). The bot does not replace it — to connect another group, first delete the old one from the list.
create.existsInactiveTitle: A group of this type is connected but inactive
create.existsInactive: {{market}} has an inactive group of this type (ID: {{groupId}}) — messages are not sent to it. Add the bot to the group again and activate it, or delete the connection and connect again.

existsInactiveReason.botRemoved: {{market}} has an inactive group of this type — the bot was removed from the group (ID: {{groupId}}). Add the bot to the group again and activate it, or delete the connection and connect again.
existsInactiveReason.sendBlocked: {{market}} has an inactive group of this type — the bot could not send to it (ID: {{groupId}}). Add the bot to the group again and activate it, or delete the connection and connect again.
existsInactiveReason.chatNotFound: {{market}} has an inactive group of this type — the group was not found (ID: {{groupId}}). Try activating it, or delete the connection and connect again.
existsInactiveReason.manual: {{market}} has a group of this type that was deactivated manually (ID: {{groupId}}). Activate it, or delete the connection and connect again.

create.linkErrorRetry: Please try again a bit later.
create.linkErrorForbidden: You are not allowed to connect a group for this market.

deleteDialog.title: Do you really want to delete it?

description.create: Messages about new orders of {{market}} will no longer be sent to this group. The group can be connected again later.
description.cancel: Messages about cancelled orders of {{market}} will no longer be sent to this group. The group can be connected again later.

deactivate.title: Confirm deactivation

description.create: Messages about new orders of {{market}} will not be sent to this group. The connection is not deleted — you can activate it again at any time from the actions menu.
description.cancel: Messages about cancelled orders of {{market}} will not be sent to this group. The connection is not deleted — you can activate it again at any time from the actions menu.

deactivate.failed: Could not deactivate the group. Please try again.

activate.title: Confirm activation

description.create: Messages about new orders of {{market}} will be sent to this group again.
description.cancel: Messages about cancelled orders of {{market}} will be sent to this group again.

activate.warningTitle: Check that the bot is in the group
activate.warning: Before activating, make sure the bot is a member of this group. If the bot is not in the group, messages will not arrive and the connection will become inactive again.

botRemoved.title: Bot was removed from the group
botRemoved.text: First add the bot to this group again, then activate. If the bot is not in the group, messages will not arrive and the connection will become inactive again.

sendBlocked.title: Bot could not send to the group
sendBlocked.text: First add the bot to this group again and allow it to post messages, then activate. Otherwise messages will not arrive and the connection will become inactive again.

chatNotFound.title: Group not found
chatNotFound.text: The group was deleted or the bot cannot reach it. If activating does not help, delete the connection and connect the group again via the bot link.

activate.failed: Could not activate the group. Please try again.
